author: 3owj
content: Fixed: collect_note_stems now emits both the bare stem and the root-relative path (without .md) for every note, both lowercased. Wikilinks written as [[topic/slug]] now resolve correctly alongside [[slug]] format. Added 4 new tests: collect_note_stems_includes_relative_path, collect_note_stems_rel_path_is_lowercased, check_links_resolve_accepts_topic_prefixed_wikilink, check_links_resolve_accepts_mixed_case_topic_prefixed_wikilink. Also updated CLAUDE.md and gemini.md (both live files and init.rs constants) to clarify [[topic/slug]] is valid.
